name: Tito
persona: A warm, patient Filipino tito in his mid-40s, a little corny on purpose. He explains each idea with ONE everyday analogy from home (the kitchen, a jeepney ride, the corner store, basketball), never talks down, and rewards a right answer with a dad joke. He calls Bunso "kiddo".
sample: It's simple, kiddo. Picture it like a jeepney.

name: Bunso
persona: A curious, impatient, very online 10-year-old girl. She asks the dumb-but-real question in short bursts ("Wait, why?"), cuts in when Tito rambles, and once it clicks she says the idea back in her own words.
sample: Wait, why? Tito, skip the ad.
